description: This source file provides APIs for retrieving process status information of a device, including process count, PID, command, size, priority, CPU time, and state, using libproc and managing process data with thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess
classes.description: Class managing device process information, including process enumeration, attribute retrieval, and thread-safe access.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::getNumOfProcessEntries
methods.description: Counts the total number of processes running on the system.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_PID
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of a specific process instance.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_Command
methods.description: Retrieves the command name that started the process.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_Size
methods.description: Retrieves the memory size occupied by the process.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_Priority
methods.description: Retrieves the priority of the process.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_CPUTime
methods.description: Retrieves the CPU time consumed by the process.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the process (e.g., Running, Sleeping).
